sources.entry: Steam Link - The Steam Link app allows you to play your Steam games across all your computers. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Steam Link
summary.one_liner: Steam Link is Valve's free iOS/iPadOS app that streams your Steam game library from a computer running Steam on the same local network to your iPhone or iPad.
use_cases: Playing existing Steam games on an iPhone or iPad
Streaming PC games to a tablet in another room of the house
Using an MFi or Steam controller with iOS games
Gaming on a Vision Pro or Apple TV via local streaming
summary.what_it_does: The app connects to a computer running Steam (Windows, Mac, or Linux) on the same local network and streams the games to an iPhone or iPad. You pair an MFi or Steam controller to the device to play. The page recommends wired Ethernet from the computer to a 5GHz WiFi router and a 5GHz WiFi connection on the iOS device for best performance. Recent updates added an HDR video setting, a brightness slider in the streaming overlays, reorganized streaming settings, and a fix for input on a secondary display.
notable: Streams Steam library over the local network rather than the internet
HDR video setting and brightness slider for streaming overlays
Listed in awesome-mac under Remote Login Software as freeware
caveats: Requires a computer running Steam on the same local network; streaming is not described as working over the internet
Requires iOS 15.0 or later, iPadOS 15.0 or later, or macOS 12.0 or later depending on device
Best performance depends on wired Ethernet and 5GHz WiFi setup
